tasks.short: Position instructions and comments on mechanical drawings

steps.what: Identify the approved instruction text and its target drawing features
Position instruction and comment annotations with leaders on the drawing
Check annotation readability, feature association and instruction fidelity and approve the final drawing
Save the approved annotation changes to the current CAD drawing

tasks.design: Configure associative annotations and placement rules in {OTHER}, the mechanical CAD system, using approved text and drafter-selected target features. The drafter resolves collisions and checks readability and meaning before approving and saving the final drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually placing and realigning repeated callouts can require many editing actions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native annotation styles and associative leaders can handle supported placements deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: A technically valid leader can point ambiguously or obscure a critical feature.
tasks.human_edge: Judge how the drawing will be read in manufacture and installation.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated annotation placement while retaining drawing clarity.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: associative CAD annotations and styles can reduce repeated placement actions, with visual review.

assumptions: Boundary is positioning supplied instructions and comments, not inventing engineering instructions or releasing the drawing externally.

The design engineer supplies approved text, instruction ID and applicable revision in existing change records. s1 counts the drafter selecting target feature/view and checking applicability; missing references require manual resolution. No semantic instruction generation occurs.

Inspect native annotation configuration first. Central hypothesis: supported repetitive placements remove 60% of s2 editing effort; collision and unusual-view work remain. If these tools are already fully used, there is no new saving.
Same-system save is approximately zero; its schema minimum 1 is retained in full. Approval follows the checked final drawing; any change invalidates it.
Provisional B=100, R=64, gross=36; focal upkeep=1; net=35. Shares come from annotation work, not means priors.
unknowns: Fraction of placements needing manual adjustment
research_questions: Time annotation editing on representative drawings and inspect readability at print scale.

already_counted.description: Check final annotation fidelity and readability

incremental.description: Maintain annotation styles and test template changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing CAD configuration already covers placement. High: repetitive placement saves 36 hours but seven extra hours of manual collision adjustment and one upkeep hour leave 28.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate component design and resolve design problems

steps.what: Open the relevant component revisions, interfaces and outstanding design issues
inputs: existing component models and drawing revisions

steps.what: Consult other workers on component design, layout, detailing and unresolved problems
outputs: agreed design resolutions and unresolved questions

steps.what: Record and approve design resolutions, owners and follow-up questions
inputs: agreed design resolutions and unresolved questions

steps.what: Save the approved design issue update in the current register

tasks.design: Link {PROJECT} design issues to exact revisions in {OTHER}, the CAD repository, to reduce preparation navigation. The consultation and actual decision recording remain with the drafter and engineering colleagues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Issue descriptions can be separated from the component revision under discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision links can open the relevant model and issue together.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve interface constraints and conflicting design goals.

ambition.what: Make design discussions start from the right revision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: revision-linked issue records can reduce navigation between design issues and their source drawings.

assumptions: Boundary includes the drafter's whole consultation and its issue note, not implementing the resulting design change. Colleagues' unchanged participation is not claimed as focal saving.

Existing issue originators already provide issue ID, component ID, revision, question and status. Native links consume these fields. Missing or obsolete links are resolved in s1. s3 explicitly counts capture of actual decisions, owner and follow-up from s2.
Check current native revision links first. Only 20% of preparation navigation is hypothesized removable; no conversation or note-writing reduction is claimed.
The same-register save is effectively zero; schema minimum 1 earns no saving. Final issue content precedes approval and edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=97, gross=3; focal incremental=0.5; net=2.5. Shares are not sized to the prompt prior.
research_questions: Trace consultation issues to the revisions actually used.

already_counted.description: Inspect revision context and resolve missing links

incremental.description: Check link failures after repository changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native revision links already suffice. High: three hours of navigation reduction require another 0.5 hours of stale-link checks and 0.5 upkeep, leaving two.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compute formulas for detailed mechanical specifications

steps.what: Select the mathematical formulas and applicable design assumptions
Enter the component parameters and units in the calculation model
Apply the formulas using computer-assisted equipment and inspect calculation errors
outputs: computed specification values and error flags

steps.what: Validate physical plausibility and approve the detailed specification values
inputs: computed specification values and error flags

steps.what: Save the approved calculation and specification in its existing file

tasks.design: Link supported component parameters in {OTHER}, the CAD model, to the existing {SPREADSHEET} calculation inputs with explicit units and revision checks. Keep formula selection, execution oversight and physical validation with the drafter; existing arithmetic runtime earns no labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some calculation inputs may still require re-entry from component models.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic parameter links can replace supported re-keying.
tasks.still_hard: Correct formulas can be applied to an unsuitable physical assumption.
tasks.human_edge: Choose assumptions and validate the resulting specification.

ambition.what: Avoid supported parameter re-entry while preserving engineering checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD parameter links can supply numeric inputs to deterministic calculation models, with unit and revision validation.

assumptions: Boundary is developing detailed specifications with computer-assisted formulas, not automating engineering judgement. Existing solver runtime is excluded; s3 measures human setup, operation and error inspection only.

Existing model authors supply component ID, revision, parameter name, value and unit in normal design work. s2 checks these against the selected input contract; absent or ambiguous parameters are entered manually. No new measurement or free upstream capture is assumed.

Check native parametric calculations first. The central hypothesis requires actual current re-keying and usable links for 40% of input-entry effort. If parameters already drive calculations, claim no new saving.
Same-file save takes approximately zero time and its minimum 1 share remains fully retained. Approval follows final validation and edits invalidate it.
Provisional B=100, R=90, gross=10; focal upkeep=1; net=9. Shares derive from calculation work, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Trace specification calculations to model parameters and measure human re-entry separately from solver runtime.

already_counted.description: Check linked units/revisions and enter unsupported inputs

incremental.description: Maintain parameter mappings and regression-check changed model schemas

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native calculations already use the model parameters. High: ten hours of re-keying reduction require three additional mapping-exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving six.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review schematics and installation questions with customers

steps.what: Locate the applicable schematic revision and installation instructions for the customer's system
inputs: existing schematics and approved installation instructions

steps.what: Confer with customer representatives to review schematics and answer installation questions
inputs: customer's installation questions and site constraints
outputs: installation questions answered and unresolved issues identified

steps.what: Record and approve the answers given and questions needing engineering follow-up
inputs: installation questions answered and unresolved issues identified

steps.what: Save the approved installation query record in the current project

tasks.design: Configure revision-filtered retrieval in {OTHER}, the drawing repository, linked to approved {DOCS} installation instructions. The drafter verifies applicability, reviews the schematics with the customer and records the actual answers and open questions in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right system revision and instruction may be held in different document sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing identifiers and revision metadata can drive deterministic retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Understand the customer's installation conditions and explain the schematic correctly.
tasks.human_edge: Answer questions in context and recognize when engineering input is needed.

ambition.what: Reduce reference retrieval during customer installation reviews.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: identifier and revision filters can retrieve applicable documents without generating installation advice.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparing references, the live customer review and its query note. It does not add an unrequested follow-up email or count redesign work as removed.

Customer system ID and questions come from the enquiry. Existing document controllers maintain document ID, system applicability, revision, approval status and instruction links. Retrieval uses those fields; missing applicability requires manual lookup in s1. Actual answers and unresolved questions are entered by the drafter in s3.

Check native document retrieval first. Only 40% of s1 lookup effort is hypothesized removable; live explanations and recording remain unchanged. No baseline of printed cards or duplicate notes is assumed.
Same-project save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Approval follows the completed note and edits void it. Live oral answers are human actions, not machine sends.
Provisional B=100, R=96.4, gross=3.6; focal upkeep=0.5; net=3.1, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Trace customer questions to the exact schematic and instruction revisions used.

already_counted.description: Verify reference applicability and resolve missing revision links

incremental.description: Audit retrieval filters after document structure changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native retrieval already finds the correct references. High: 3.6 hours of lookup reduction require 1.1 extra applicability checks and 0.5 upkeep, leaving two.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Drafters retain design interpretation and coordination while native CAD annotation, parameter and revision tools remove supported editing or navigation.
role.ambitious_version: A mechanical drafter whose drawings and calculations stay linked to their sources while judgement and customer explanation remain human.
